guide.title: How to get the token
guide.step1: On your Mac, run `claude setup-token` in a terminal.
guide.step2: Sign in with the same Claude account the instance uses.
guide.step3: Copy the whole output and paste it above.
guide.note: The token is valid for a year, can be revoked on claude.ai and runs on your existing subscription.
guide.warning: Do not paste the token into a chat.
